cybersecurity/cloud-vps-hardening.h1: Cloudflare Edge WAF & Hardened Docker VPS Architecture
cybersecurity/cloud-vps-hardening.subheadline: Eliminate public IP attack surfaces with Cloudflare zero-trust tunnels, automated edge WAF rules, and isolated Docker container bridge networks on Linux VPS instances.

metrics.sub: Complete ingress port invisibility via tunnels
TLS 1.3 with strict HSTS, CSP, and CORS

cybersecurity/cloud-vps-hardening.deep_dive_1: Enterprise cybersecurity platforms must demonstrate unassailable infrastructure security posture to pass rigorous enterprise vendor assessments and SOC2 compliance audits. Our hardening architecture routes all production traffic through encrypted Cloudflare zero-trust tunnels, eliminating open inbound firewall ports and hiding origin server IPs from public DNS scanners.
cybersecurity/cloud-vps-hardening.deep_dive_2: Behind the edge WAF, application services execute within hardened Docker Compose environments featuring isolated bridge networks, read-only file systems, and non-root execution users, completely preventing host-level lateral escalation.

pain_points.title: Exposed Public IP Addresses and Automated Port Scans
pain_points.description: Hosting services directly on public IPs leaves server ports open to continuous automated dictionary and port scanning attacks.
pain_points.impact: Elevated intrusion risk and server compromise.

pain_points.title: DDoS Traffic Volatility and Costly Cloud Egress
pain_points.description: Unprotected origin servers suffer performance bottlenecks or unexpected cloud overage bills during aggressive scraper or DDoS spikes.
pain_points.impact: Cost overruns and degraded user experience during critical commercial events.

pain_points.title: Exhausting Enterprise Procurement and Security Questionnaires
pain_points.description: Security engineering teams waste hundreds of hours manually filling repetitive 250-question CAIQ and SIG enterprise vendor assessments.
pain_points.impact: Protracted 9-12 month sales cycles and stalled deal progression.

capabilities.title: Cloudflare Zero-Trust Tunneling Architecture
capabilities.spec: Cloudflared daemon connecting origin servers directly to Cloudflare edge without public open ports.
capabilities.deliverable: Complete server invisibility against automated port scanning tools.

capabilities.title: Hardened Docker Compose Container Networks
capabilities.spec: Isolated bridge networks with non-root runtime users, resource memory limits, and read-only volumes.
capabilities.deliverable: Defense-in-depth container isolation preventing host escalation.

capabilities.title: Automated TLS 1.3 & HTTP Security Headers
capabilities.spec: Automated certificate renewal paired with strict HSTS, Content-Security-Policy, and CORS enforcement.
capabilities.deliverable: A+ rating on Qualys SSL Labs security assessments.

capabilities.title: Real-Time Telemetry & Failover Alerting
capabilities.spec: Container healthcheck monitors with automated service restarts and instant Telegram/Slack incident webhooks.
capabilities.deliverable: 99.99% service availability with zero unmonitored server crashes.

phases.title: Base Linux VPS Hardening & SSH Lockdown
phases.desc: Deploy Ubuntu LTS, disable root password logins, configure UFW, and install fail2ban.

phases.title: Docker Security Configuration & Network Bridges
phases.desc: Implement non-root daemon settings, isolated bridge networks, and memory bounds.

phases.title: Cloudflare Tunnel & Edge WAF Policies
phases.desc: Deploy cloudflared daemon, bind DNS CNAMEs, and activate rate-limiting WAF rules.

phases.title: Penetration Testing & Security Report Handoff
phases.desc: Execute automated vulnerability scans, verify SSL headers, and deliver operational runbooks.

faqs.q: How do Cloudflare zero-trust tunnels eliminate open firewall ports?
faqs.a: The cloudflared daemon establishes an outbound-only connection to Cloudflare edge points, allowing secure traffic routing without opening any inbound ports on your server firewall.

faqs.q: Will this architecture pass SOC2 Type II and ISO 27001 infrastructure audits?
faqs.a: Yes. Our defense-in-depth configuration enforces non-root container isolation, encrypted transit, automated logging, and least-privilege network policies.

faqs.q: How are DDoS attacks and malicious scrapers mitigated?
faqs.a: Cloudflare Edge WAF inspects and filters malicious requests at the global edge network before traffic ever reaches your VPS origin.

faqs.q: Can we run self-hosted databases securely in this environment?
faqs.a: Yes. Databases run on isolated internal Docker networks accessible only to authorized container services, with zero public internet exposure.

faqs.q: What happens if a Docker container crashes unexpectedly?
faqs.a: Docker healthchecks detect service degradation instantly, trigger automated container restarts, and dispatch an incident webhook to your team.
